description:
Milye Gujranwala sey taluk rakhney waley taraqi pasand kissan Ahtesham Qureshi se, jo Gandum ki fasal ke kashtkaar hein. Ahtesham ney Sarsabz Nitrophos aur CAN gawara ke estimaal sey apni Gandum ki fasal mein hasil ki 18% izaafi paidawaar!
#Sarsabz #SalamKissan #SarsabzPakistan
